## Status

This ticket's former standalone plan is superseded. Its valid production contract has been moved into fz-kdt.48, where it can land atomically with the authority it depends on.

## Preserved requirement

Anonymous callable literals and bare callable surfaces remain distinct; an anonymous alternative cannot disappear beside branded alternatives.

No implementation from this ticket is to be restored or landed separately. Consult fz-kdt.48 for the current goal, signal, strategy, TDD, deletion list and ordering. This description replaces the former plan; comments or parked candidates are historical evidence only.
